definitions.gloss: being choosy; picking and choosing; fussiness
definitions.explanation: Accepting only what suits one's taste and rejecting the rest, usually said critically, of food, work, partners and so on.

examples.japanese: {選|え}り{好|ごの}み⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{選|え}り{好|ごの}み⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: This is no time to be choosy about work.
As a child I was very fussy about food, but now I eat anything.

notes:
{選|え}る (an older reading of ⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧, to choose) + ⟦{好|この}み→好み：02767_konomi⟧ (liking). Also read よりごのみ. Usually appears in the negative or in criticism.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {選|え}り{好|ごの}み⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be picky
- {選|え}り{好|ごの}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧: to be very choosy
- {選|え}り{好|ごの}みせず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: without being picky
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{選|え}り{好|ごの}み⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to pick and choose one's jobs

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{好|す}き{嫌|きら}い→好き嫌い：12206_sukikirai⟧: likes and dislikes — especially picky eating (⟦{好|す}き{嫌|きら}い→好き嫌い：12206_sukikirai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧)
- ⟦{贅沢|ぜいたく}→贅沢：03309_zeitaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}わない→言う：00515_iu⟧: not to ask for too much — the other usual phrase for being easy to please
